conditionalOls.note: Descriptive. Not used for selection. Proper scoring remains primary.
conditionalOls.reason: executionPenalty is identically zero on every row, so its column has zero variance and the full design is singular -- which is the decomposition's central finding expressed as linear algebra, not a modelling nuisance

decomposition.conclusion: production's executable price IS the vig-free midpoint, so EXECUTION_PENALTY is identically zero and declaredEdge == MODEL_SIGNAL exactly

filterSimulations.reason: mechanism is CASE_A_MODEL_SIGNAL_INVERSION; a spread/staleness filter has no mechanism to act on, so simulating one would be post-hoc fishing

h2_executionPenalty.note: Production prices against the midpoint, so its declared edge omits the half-spread a taker actually pays. That makes its stated edge optimistic; it does not make the edge inversion an execution artifact.

h4_liquidity.note: Descriptive only. Archived fields exclusively; no volume/depth data exists to use.

h7_thresholdTail.note: Ladder rungs share a player-game and are never counted as independent.

mechanismDetail: model-minus-fair-market disagreement itself degrades as it grows, and the execution penalty is identically zero in production's declared edge, so execution cost cannot be the cause
